summaries.en: The Board of Audit and Inspection has begun a three-week on-site audit, starting today, of the Korea Football Association and city/provincial professional football clubs regarding suspected waste of taxpayer money and their use of public funds.
summaries.zh: 韩国审计院今日起对大韩足球协会和市道民职业足球俱乐部展开为期三周的实地审计，调查其涉嫌浪费税款和公共资金的使用情况。
